defects.description: Image lacks sharpness and crisp detail throughout. Overall soft focus makes image appear мыльно (soapy/blurry).
defects.recommended_action: increase sharpening, adjust CFG scale, change sampler, add anti-blur prompt guard, increase denoise strength

defects.description: Eyes show generative artifacts. Pupils/irises lack clean definition. Eye shape distorted. Loss of realistic eye detail.
defects.recommended_action: add eye detail prompt guard, increase face region resolution, use face restore or inpainting for eyes

defects.description: Eyelashes are clumped, missing, or artifacted. Natural eyelash structure not preserved.
defects.recommended_action: add eyelash detail prompt guard, increase detail in eye region

defects.description: Mouth area shows distortion. Teeth poorly formed or missing. Mouth shape appears artificial.
defects.recommended_action: add mouth/teeth prompt guard, reduce smile intensity, add negative prompt for bad teeth

defects.description: Skin is excessively smoothed with loss of natural micro-detail. Pores and skin texture absent.
defects.recommended_action: reduce face smoothing, add skin detail prompt, reduce denoise, change checkpoint to one with natural skin detail

defects.description: Facial skin has waxy, plastic-like appearance. Lacks natural skin reflectance and micro-texture. Characteristic of over-smoothed generative output.
defects.recommended_action: reduce CFG scale, change sampler to one with more natural detail (DPM++ 2M Karras), add skin texture prompt, consider different checkpoint

defects.description: Hair is rendered as soft blobs rather than individual strands. Hair detail is not sharp or readable.
defects.recommended_action: add hair detail prompt guard, increase detail in hair region, add negative prompt for soft hair

defects.description: Quality reference (V6 elderly portrait / бабка) did not successfully transfer its sharpness, skin detail, and natural appearance to V7 output. V7 is softer and more synthetic than the quality reference.
defects.recommended_action: increase IP-Adapter/ControlNet strength for quality reference, adjust reference conditioning, check reference image compatibility
